common_name: Adaptive RK4 step-doubling trajectories with J2
scientific_use: Propagate independent orbits with explicit local error estimates, rejected steps and bounded-work failure statuses.

canonical_equations: One RK4 step h vs two steps h/2; accept fine state when max(abs(fine-coarse)/15/(atol[k]+rtol*max(abs(old),abs(fine))))<=1; halve on rejection, double after acceptance if error<=1/32; clamp final step to remaining duration.
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; states[N,6],N1..64; shared mu>=0,reference_radius>=0,j2; duration>=0;0<dt_min<=dt_initial<=dt_max;atol[6]>0,rtol>=0;max_attempts1..128,N*max_attempts<=2048; finite RN32 intermediates.
output_contract: N x [u32 status,attempts,accepted,rejected,f32 elapsed,last_error,next_dt,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz]; status0 completed,1 attempt limit,2 step/time resolution limit,3 singular force; nonzero status retains last accepted state. Local error is a numerical estimate, not global error proof; CPU/GPU allowed differing bits remains0.
result_contract: N x [u32 status,attempts,accepted,rejected,f32 elapsed,last_error,next_dt,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz]; status0 completed,1 attempt limit,2 step/time resolution limit,3 singular force; nonzero status retains last accepted state. Local error is a numerical estimate, not global error proof; CPU/GPU allowed differing bits remains0.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
